MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_TRANSMIGRATION.desc:
A gift from [color=#CC6666]【Death Rewind】[/color], a curse from [color=#CC6666]【Death Rewind】[/color]
When you play a card with [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration】[/color], automatically play cards of the same name with [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration】[/color] from your draw pile (up to 2).
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_TRANSMIGRATION3.des: When you play a card with [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration III】[/color], play cards with [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration III】[/color] from anywhere.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.title: Agree
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.description:
When played, triggers effects at multiples of 1 through 5:
×1: Grant 3 Block to all allies.
×2: Gain 3 Block.
×3: Grant 1 temporary Haste to all allies.
×4: Grant 2 temporary Strength to all allies.
×5: A random card in hand can be played for free once. All allies gain 1 Energy.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.title: Doubt
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.description:
When played, triggers effects at multiples of 1 through 5:
×1: Gain 1 Block.
×2: Draw 1 card.
×3: Gain 1 Energy.
×4: Retrieve 1 card from the discard pile.
×5: Add Replay 1 to a card in hand. Apply 1 [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Trial[/color][color=#6699cc] Enchantment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] to a card in hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.title: Rebuttal
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.descriptio:
When played, triggers effects at multiples of 1 through 5:
×1: Deal 1 damage randomly.
×2: Gain 1 Strength.
×3: Apply 1 Vulnerable to all enemies.
×4: Deal 1 damage randomly an equal number of times.
×5: This card is played 1 extra time.
